_send_email_sync uses asyncio.run inside FastAPI background tasks; if a request hops between events this is fine, but it spins up a new event loop per email — acceptable given low volume.

APScheduler uses MemoryJobStore — reminders are lost on backend restart. Acceptable for iteration 4 since the user noted Supabase migration is queued; flag for the next iteration to switch to MongoDBJobStore or persisted scheduling.
